column1: # The issue of a door token (the door token contract, «The token»): issue(seed_hex, kid, claims) → claims_jcs and token.
# seed_hex — the 32 bytes of an Ed25519 seed (RFC 8032), as seed_secret of the row door/signer; claims — a JSON object, as passed
# to the issuer (expires = now + 120); claims_jcs — its RFC 8785 form (UTF-8); token — door1.<kid>.<claims>.<sig>.

column8: ordinary: the fields in the order of the contract, expires = now + 120
the fields in reverse order: JCS sorts the keys — claims and token are the same as basic's
JCS does not sort the array routes: the order as passed, the token differs from basic's
Cyrillic and a character outside the BMP in user and unit: JCS writes UTF-8 as is, without \u
a quote and a backslash — by escaping, «/» as is, U+001F — \u001f in lower case
expires passed with an exponent (1.79245452E9): JCS writes the number as the integer 1792454520
kid of 32 characters [a-z0-9-] — the largest in form; the second seed
